description: This script generates a Kconfig file for Petalinux by parsing recipe information, managing directories, and performing sanity checks. It integrates with BitBake and uses external command utilities.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Appends a string to the output Kconfig file.

methods.name: sanity_test
methods.description: Runs a bitbake command to verify the generated Kconfig file.

methods.name: rename_dir
methods.description: Renames a directory if it exists.

methods.name: kconfig_recipe_format
methods.description: Formats recipe data into Kconfig menu entries.

methods.name: get_exclude_pkgs
methods.description: Reads exclude package patterns from a JSON file.

methods.name: plnxkconfig
methods.description: Main function to generate the Kconfig file based on recipes and their metadata.

methods.name: register_commands
methods.description: Registers the CLI command for generating the Petalinux Kconfig.
